name: Custom automation
description: Create a custom automation from a prompt, plugin-powered prompt, or uploaded script tarball.

github.message: Optional. Used when you choose a GitHub repository to clone or trigger from GitHub events.

exampleImplementation:
Action: a user-selected prompt, plugin, or uploaded tarball creation path
Trigger: a user-selected cron schedule or event source and event type

1. Ask whether the automation should run a prompt, run a prompt with plugins, or upload a tarball.
2. Render only the fields for the selected creation path.
3. Create prompt automations through /v1/preset/prompt, plugin automations through /v1/preset/plugin, and uploaded tarball automations by uploading to /v1/uploads then creating through /v1.
4. The selected trigger and common run settings are shared by all creation paths.

form.note: Choose whether this custom automation runs a plain prompt, a prompt with plugins, or your own uploaded tarball. Prompt and plugin runs use the LLM; uploaded tarballs are best for deterministic scripts.

schedule.label: Schedule
schedule.help: How often this automation should run.

timezone.label: Timezone
timezone.help: Timezone used to evaluate the schedule.

source.label: Event source
source.help: Webhook source that starts the automation.

on.label: Event type
on.help: Event key or wildcard pattern that starts the automation.

filter.label: Event filter
filter.help: Optional JMESPath expression evaluated against the event payload.

name.label: Automation name
name.help: Name shown in the automations list.

model.label: LLM profile
model.help: Optional model profile used for automation runs. Leave blank to use the active profile.

timeout.label: Timeout (seconds)
timeout.help: Maximum time a single run may take. Leave blank for the service default.

prompt.label: Prompt
prompt.help: Run a natural-language prompt with the default OpenHands agent.

prompt.label: Prompt
prompt.help: Instructions the agent follows every time the automation runs.
prompt.placeholder: Summarize recent repository activity and post the result to Slack.

repository.label: Repository
repository.help: Optional GitHub repository to clone before each run.

ref.label: Branch or ref
ref.help: Branch, tag, or commit to check out when a repository is selected.

plugin.label: Plugin
plugin.help: Run a prompt with one or more OpenHands plugins loaded.

plugins.label: Plugins
plugins.help: One or more plugin sources to load. Each source may include an optional ref and repository path.

prompt.label: Prompt
prompt.help: Instructions the agent follows after loading the plugins.
prompt.placeholder: Use the plugin commands to inspect the repository and summarize findings.

repository.label: Repository
repository.help: Optional GitHub repository to clone before each run.

ref.label: Branch or ref
ref.help: Branch, tag, or commit to check out when a repository is selected.

upload.label: Upload tarball
upload.help: Upload a .tar or .tar.gz containing the automation code to run.

tarball.label: Tarball
tarball.help: A .tar or .tar.gz archive containing the automation code. Maximum size is enforced by the automation service.

entrypoint.label: Entrypoint
entrypoint.help: Command to run after the tarball is extracted.

setupScript.label: Setup script
setupScript.help: Optional path inside the tarball to run before the entrypoint.

setup.message: This deployment cannot create custom automations directly. Set it up in this conversation instead: choose prompt, plugin, or uploaded tarball mode; confirm the selected trigger, model profile, timeout, and mode-specific fields; then create the automation.
